name: @kwpledger/swiss-deck
description: Builds the Swiss deck PowerPoint template from the tokens. Kept out of the root package so the design system stays dependency-free.

scripts.build: node build.js template && python3 post.py template-raw.pptx Swiss-Deck-Template.potx && node build.js sample && python3 post.py sample-raw.pptx Swiss-Deck-Sample.pptx
